reference.title: Scenario 3: Table with no header row
reference.shortdesc: Consider a Markdown table that contains only data rows and does not include a header

section.p: Consider a Markdown table that contains only data rows and does not include a header row.

entry.codeblock: | Critical | High | Immediate action required | | Warning | Medium | Requires investigation | | Informational | Low | Informational event |

Critical High Immediate action required
Warning Medium Requires investigation
Informational Low Informational event

section.p: Result: The converter generates a DITA <simpletable> without a <sthead> element because no header row is present in the source Markdown table. Each row is converted directly into a <strow>, and each cell becomes an <stentry>.
section.note: Tables without header rows are more difficult to understand and may reduce accessibility in published output. Whenever possible, include a descriptive header row to identify the purpose of each column.
